A1_context: M01-S2 HOST definition codec/create/save/adopt; existing WORK domain accepted. UI/native/session ownership in S3.
A2_hexagonal: UI/native picker → Tauri → DispatchHost → HOST usecases → WORK; HOST → FileSystemPort(read)/FileCommitPort(write) ← Windows adapter.
A3_module_dependency: src-tauri → HOST → WORK + PORTS; ADAPTERS → PORTS + existing SPEC hash. No HOST std::fs, WORK serde, or UI adapter call.
A4_responsibility: WORK owns typed content rules; HOST owns mapping/orchestration; DispatchHost owns live binding/draft/peer projection; adapter owns OS handles/scratch.
A6_output_ports: Existing FileSystemPort read/exists/is_file; FileCommitPort exclusive create/acquire; lease read_current/replace_checked. No new Port.
A7_driving: Tests, then authorized S3 caller; no new global service.
A8_driven: Existing Windows IO adapter; test-only commit doubles backed by same fixture FS.
A9_direction: Adapters implement inward Ports; HOST maps DTO, Domain does not serialize.
A10_ownership: S2 returns immutable proof/binding, never registers active project or UUID. Caller must recheck current owner/session before applying returned binding.
A11_mutation: Only save requests writes through commit Port. No write_atomic/create_dir_all/remove_file in new store/create path; no source mutation.
A12_transaction: Root/metadata/definition/preferences are ordered steps, each formal file its own IO transaction. Definition first, prefs second. Later failure never rolls back a committed definition.
A13_external: Current IO local-scope accepted on Windows10; Windows11/reparse/8.3 remain separate. Existing read ports read whole files: codec cap is post-read, not bounded OS allocation. No universal CAS/power-loss promise.
